subject: Problem printing greyscale or B&W ggplot2 images

messages.author: afe004a247e18cee
messages.subject: Problem printing greyscale or B&W ggplot2 images
parts:
I have an issue with printing/creating black and white and greyscale
images with ggplot2.

I have been trying to make some black and white, and greyscale
graphics for publication, they look perfect on mine and everyone's
monitors, but came out in colour when printed. (An awful photo of the
result is here: http://i.imgur.com/UuB6A.jpg)

For example:

-----------------------------------------------------------------
p <- qplot(displ, hwy, data = mpg)
p <- p + facet_wrap(~ cyl) + theme_bw()

pdf("testplot.pdf",width=7.6,height=3.6)
p
dev.off()
-----------------------------------------------------------------

The generated image and output pdf looks perfect onscreen, but the
facets borders and titles are in a shade of red when printed. Try it!

I get the same results when outputting to a .png, and also when I
print directly from the R graphics window. According to my friend with
some experience with image manipulation, the images I've sent him have
bits of colour in them according to the colour histogram. (http://
i.imgur.com/v13dD.png)

Is there any way to generate true B&W and greyscale images using
ggplot? I tried forcing greyscale (perhaps very naively!) by using
'colormodel="gray"' in the pdf() command, but it does not make a
difference.

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: Problem printing greyscale or B&W ggplot2 images
parts:
This might be a dumb question, but are you sure it's not a problem with your printer? Do PNG images (of this graph and, say, grayscale photos) come out OK?

Even if it's not your printer per se, it's possible that you have some sort of color profile set in your printer driver that's throwing things off.

messages.subject: Re: Problem printing greyscale or B&W ggplot2 images
